author: Mark Atwood
text:
VERIFIED COMPLETE 2026-11-24, except for one thing only Mark can do.

All 11 children are closed, and the epic's own description is met:

- S1, the TLS listener on a chosen address, off by default, same token,
  refuse without TLS: bead mimid-e13m.3, amended for the plain IRC
  listener by decision mimid-1wgh.92 and recorded as such in
  client-survey.md §10.
- S2, queries as one-to-one rooms and chathistory from the store:
  mimid-i0id.1 and .2.
- S3, SASL PLAIN with the agent token, PASS kept: mimid-e13m.4, with
  docs/irc-lessons.md updated (it offers `sasl=PLAIN,SCRAM-SHA-256`).
- S4, push on by default with minimal payloads: mimid-i0id.4.
- The decisions are recorded where the description asked: client-survey.md
  §10 "Decisions (Mark, 2026-11-21)" S1-S7, and agent-frontends.md §7
  items 32, 33 and 35 cite them. /data/tmp/survey-decisions.txt is gone,
  as a file under /tmp was always going to be, so §10 is now the record.

The dependency on mimid-e13m is still open, but the part of it IRC v2
needs is not: frontend-auth.md §9 names steps 1 to 5 and 11 as "the part
IRC v2 needs", and all six (mimid-e13m.1 .2 .3 .4 .5 .11) are closed.
What keeps mimid-e13m open is Matrix (.7), XMPP (.10), social login (.15,
.16) and .17, none of which IRC needs.

NOT CLOSING IT, because the epic is named for a real client and nothing
here has met one: every test is mimid talking to itself or to a stock Rust
JMAP client. Goguma on an actual phone against an actual tailnet address
is the acceptance test, and it is Mark's to run. If it passes, close this;
if it does not, the bug belongs to whichever child it lands in.
